notes: V30.38 runs the hierarchical RGB/pose/depth estimator during acquisition in a dedicated time-sliced worker. A working candidate never changes the visible measurement state until a conservative acceptance gate checks reprojection, pose jumps, depth calibration and switch behaviour. Accepted sparse anchors are smoothed before display; rejected candidates leave the preview untouched. The diagnostics logger is upgraded to structured ROOMSCAN-V30-DIAGNOSTICS-2 with monotonic sequence/timing, checkpoints, runtime context, worker traces and explicit accepted/rejected optimisation decisions.
